tracks.name: ActPrune OFT LIBERO 4 suites · Table I
tracks.split: OpenVLA-OFT unchanged checkpoint, 100/50/25/12.5% visual token retention
tracks.protocol: Author-source Table I original four-suite evaluation; original OFT baseline and ActPrune retained budget variants, no cross-backbone pooling.
tracks.trainingRegime: Official OpenVLA-OFT pretrained and posttrained checkpoint; geometric early pruning needs no additional learned selector.

tracks.name: ActPrune OFT policy latency · Table I
tracks.split: Author method same GPU/protocol, policy milliseconds represented as seconds
tracks.protocol: Table I policy inference latency including pruning overhead; do not interpret as full robot episode or compare across unrelated GPU setups.
tracks.trainingRegime: Same OpenVLA-OFT weights without new pruning-network training.

tracks.name: ActPrune π0.5 LIBERO four suites · Table II
tracks.split: π0.5 unchanged checkpoint; 100/50/25/12.5% visual token retention
tracks.protocol: Table II π0.5 results independent of OFT; action expert repeated flow steps present, latency speedup much smaller.
tracks.trainingRegime: π0.5 checkpoint with pretrained robot policy, no additional ActPrune selector training.

tracks.name: ActPrune π0.5 policy latency · Table II
tracks.split: Author millisecond source values divided by 1000 to seconds
tracks.protocol: Full π0.5 policy inference latency with flow matching action expert, not full trajectory duration.
tracks.trainingRegime: Unchanged π0.5 policy weights, geometric pruning at inference.

tracks.name: ActPrune VLABench π0.5 ten primitive tasks · Table III
tracks.tasks: 10 selected VLABench primitive tasks, 50 episodes each
tracks.split: π0.5 official checkpoint fine-tuned on these 10 tasks, 100/50/25% token retention
tracks.protocol: The 10-task VLABench subset is not full 100-category/2000-object benchmark; 25% retained success notably degrades to 13.7%.
tracks.trainingRegime: π0.5 posttrained on the ten source-specific VLABench tasks before pruning, no retraining for ActPrune.

tracks.name: ActPrune Franka four real task success · Table VII
tracks.split: Four tasks, 10 trials each; LoRA task-adapted DROID π0.5, 100/50/25/12.5% visual retained
tracks.protocol: Paper real robot case study not RoboDojo official; 10 per task, 40 rollouts per method. Real SR degrades 60%→50% at 50% retention.
tracks.trainingRegime: DROID pretraining π0.5 plus 20K local LoRA steps; ActPrune is inference-only geometric pruning; RealSense D435 RGBD and RTX PRO4500.

tracks.name: ActPrune Franka policy seconds · Table VII
tracks.tasks: Franka four real tasks, inference on RTX PRO4500
tracks.split: Table VII millisecond per inference converted to seconds
tracks.protocol: Original real-robot policy inference latency, not full task execution wall clock; pair only with same retained-ratio SR track.
tracks.trainingRegime: Same DROID-initialized π0.5 LoRA checkpoint for source real tasks, no pruning-network training.

tracks.name: ActPrune fixed/wrist camera pruning contribution · Table IV
tracks.tasks: 4 LIBERO suites, π0.5 source method ablation
tracks.split: 25% retained token ratio; enable patch/embedding pruning per camera
tracks.protocol: Table IV variants with different view-level pruning; all-views lowest FLOPs can have lower success than one-view ablation. Not official method ranks.
tracks.trainingRegime: Same π0.5 backbone; changes to inference pruning branches, no new policies trained.

tracks.name: ActPrune trajectory history and extrapolation · Table Va
tracks.protocol: Table Va original author evaluation; 5/0, 3/3, 0/5 past/future geometric points; not future observation leakage.
tracks.trainingRegime: Only inference-time geometry projection horizon changed, VLA checkpoint constant.

tracks.name: ActPrune context-token grid size · Table VIb
tracks.split: 25% retained; context grid M=0/1/2/4/8 on OFT
tracks.protocol: Table VIb context grid granularity on OpenVLA-OFT; 2x2 gives 96.1% while 8x8 degrades to 93.1%.
tracks.trainingRegime: Only source ActPrune context merging grid choice changed; encoder weights unchanged.
